title: Snaptape Measurement Schema v1.2 (whole building, US/English)
description: Full building: lists of faces, edges, openings. Internal units are millimeters (unrounded); display converts to imperial (ft-in, sq ft, pitch x/12). US construction terms. v1.2 adds Hover-proven elements: roof flashing/step-flashing edges, three-stage pitch (original/rounded/snapped), soffit depth, window group_id, patio_door/skylight, chimney attachment, user_provided reference. Calculated values (waste, united inches, squares, gutter runs) stay in the calculation layer, NOT here. ID MIGRATION MAP from v1.0 (German): D-→RF-, W-→WL-, U-→SF-, B-→FC-, K-→E-, F-→W-, T-→D-, G-→G-, A-→AT-. CAUTION: new 'D-' = door (old 'D-' was roof face), new 'W-' = window (old 'W-' was wall). Never mix v1.0 and v1.2 IDs in one project.

unit.description: Internal storage unit, unrounded. Display layer converts to imperial (ft-in, sq ft, pitch x/12); raw mm shown in tooltips.

index.description: 1-based, matches the photo numbering used in prompts.

shows_elevation.description: front = street-facing side, as seen from the street. Never guess compass directions.

building.description: Elevations are named functionally: front = street-facing side, back = garden side, left/right as seen FROM the street. Compass orientation is derived deterministically from the address later, never guessed from photos.

footprint.description: Outline. Points as [x,y] mm clockwise from front-left corner; or simplified width/depth.

shared_walls.description: For duplex/townhouse: which elevation is a shared (party) wall.

references.description: One scale per photo. A scale never carries across photos. Priority order: user_provided (overrides everything) > own_reference (tier-3 normed object) > transferred.

scale_type.description: user_provided = a measurement entered by the user; it overrides ALL assumptions.

transferred_via.description: Only if scale_type=transferred: shared element + source photo, e.g. 'window W-2 width from photo 1'

user_confirmed.description: True if the user confirmed a DETECTED reference. Not the same as scale_type=user_provided.

faces.description: All building faces (roof faces, walls, soffits, fascia).

soffit_depth_mm.description: Only for soffit/fascia faces (roofline overhang depth). Hover-style.

pitch.description: Roof faces only. Three-stage like Hover: exact, rounded, and snapped to a common pitch.

rise_over_12_snapped.description: US pitch snapped to a common value, rise per 12 run (e.g. 6 = 6/12)

orientation_deg.description: Azimuth, roof only. Derived from address later; null from photos.

edges.description: All edges with class and length. US roofing/siding terms. Roof-metal edges (flashing, step_flashing) included. 'unclassified' is kept and shown, never silently dropped (completeness signal). Note: gutter/downspout runs are DERIVED from eave edges in the calculation layer, not stored here.

openings.description: All windows, doors, garage doors, skylights across the building. patio_door is separate because US siding-waste rules treat garage/patio doors differently (<20 sq ft excl. vs <33 sq ft incl.).

id.description: W=window, D=door, G=garage door, SK=skylight. CAUTION vs v1.0: old D- was roof face, old W- was wall.

group_id.description: Optional window group (shared trim), Hover-style WG-x. Group metrics (group width/height, united inches) live in the calculation layer.

position_mm.description: x/y of the opening's lower-left corner, from the lower-left corner of its elevation.

note.description: Single source of truth for this text is the app config; keep in sync.

attachments.description: Optional extra volumes/obstacles for the massing kit (dormer, bay, balcony, awning, addition, chimney).
